title: Hollow Men Gather
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Red biohazard on black, with a yellow caution stripe. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Hollow Men Gather. Drawing this card is not an Infection card draw. Draw the next Infection card and add a Hollow Men figure to that city instead of infecting it. If that card is another Hollow Men Gather, keep drawing, and add only 1 figure to the first city revealed. The printed code on this scan is P2-21b.

rules: This card is in the Infection deck, but drawing it does not count as an Infection card draw.
Draw the next Infection card. Add a Hollow Men figure to that city instead of infecting it.
If the next card is another Hollow Men Gather, keep drawing. Add only 1 figure, and add it to the first city you reveal.
When the package is opened, this card goes to the Infection discard pile with the other Gather cards. The report places all 4.
notes: Card id 10722. Copies in the manifest: 1.
The code printed on the face is P2-21b, the Package 2 Gather face, not a P3 code. The same face is used for cards 22, 23, and 24.
Side A is the Infection deck back. There is no city, no search, and no improvement panel.
One copy uses this folder. Card 24 supplies the other two copies of the same face.
